title: PopResume: Causal Fairness Evaluation of LLM/VLM Resume Screeners with Population-Representative Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating path-specific causal effects (PSEs) on model-assigned resume suitability scores using a synthetic, population-representative resume dataset, decomposing the total effect into direct effects, business-necessity indirect effects (qualifications), and redlining indirect effects (demographic proxies).
Estimating path-specific causal effects (PSEs) on resume screening scores for White versus Non-White candidates using the same population-representative dataset and causal pathway decomposition.
